subject: Render draft consistency: constant-blob extra binding and indexed identity
body: One draft consistency issue before tests: tegu_generic_compile_exact exempts GENERIC_CONSTANT from reverse-set requirement, but snapshot_rt later loop repeats missing-reflection check and exempts only NEUTRAL_IMAGE/BUFFER, so the same constant extra fails there (current lines1999-2001). Your magma probe plan7/native6 needs exact missing-binding identity recorded. ConstantBlob is conceptually a buffer descriptor, not always absent from native resources; optimize-away cases need a documented reason for legitimate planner extras, not all-kind exemptions by assumption. Please test actual magma snapshot through final changed code, not only baseline bridge/native compile independently. Binding-keyed retention ACK remains. For VertexIndex refusal, preserve existing direct indexed vertex-pulling semantics if raw indices are already supplied via IDVS (generic request.index path); indexed attribute expansion loses original IDs but direct indexed/no-attribute path may already preserve them. Ask lowering/backend owner before refusing every drawIndexSize.
